_comment: Proposed CCRDI palette (brief/design.md), for the brand specimen only (/component-lab/brand, dev only). Once a layout variant is chosen these values move into site.config.json → brand.colors and this file goes on the cleanup list.

colors.name: Ink
colors.use: header, hero, footer, dark sections, body text

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.use: secondary dark panels, cards on Ink

colors.name: CCRDI Red
colors.use: buttons, links and eyebrows on light

colors.name: Signal Red
colors.use: marks and large text on Ink

colors.name: Wine
colors.use: button hover, red text with extra contrast

colors.name: Blush
colors.use: light end of a red data ramp; text on Ink

colors.name: Silver
colors.use: hairlines on light; secondary text on Ink

colors.name: Steel
colors.use: muted text on Ink; chart bars

colors.name: Slate
colors.use: captions and secondary text on light
